references.text: God's original instructions to Moses on how the menorah (lampstand) should be made. Exodus 37:17 describes the fulfillment of these instructions.
Parallel text describing that the lampstand was to be made of pure gold, hammered work, with a shaft, branches, cups, knobs, and flowers.
Mentions the lampstand of pure gold as part of the tabernacle's equipment that Bezalel was to make.
Describes the placement of the lampstand in the tabernacle after it was completed.
Confirms that the lampstand was made of hammered gold, from its shaft to its flowers, according to the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
The golden lampstands that Solomon made for the temple, based on the original design from the tabernacle.
Zechariah's vision of a golden lampstand, connecting to the symbolism of the tabernacle's menorah.
Mentions the lampstand as part of the furnishings of the Holy Place in the tabernacle.
John's vision of seven golden lampstands, symbolically connected to the tabernacle's lampstand.
Explanation of the seven golden lampstands as the seven churches, a continuation of the lampstand's symbolism.
Confirms that the lampstand was a single work made from one talent of pure gold.
